objective: Build and validate a pinned source Codex CLI and app-server baseline without changing upstream core.
claim_ceiling: Local source build and offline interface equivalence only; no behavioral, provider, model-quality, or training claim.

network_effects: fetch Rust toolchain and Cargo dependencies

stop_rules: stop before any live inference request
stop before modifying a non-house upstream source file
stop if free disk falls below 20 GiB
stop after a repeated build failure and preserve the first actionable error
